parameters.query: {{ "SELECT o.order_id::text, o.order_date::text, o.status, " +"COALESCE(SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity)::text, '0') as total_amount, " +"COALESCE(STRING_AGG(d.name, ', '), 'No drugs recorded') as drugs " +"FROM orders o " +"LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id " +"LEFT JOIN drugs d ON d.drug_id = oi.drug_id " +"LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id " +"WHERE c.customer_id = '" + ($(\'Webhook\').first().json.body.customer_id || '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') + "' " +"GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date, o.status " +"ORDER BY o.order_date DESC LIMIT 5" }}

{{ "SELECT cc.last_purchase_date::text, cc.avg_cycle_days, d.name as drug_name, d.category " +"FROM customer_cycles cc " +"LEFT JOIN drugs d ON d.drug_id = cc.drug_id " +"WHERE cc.customer_id = '" + ($(\'Webhook\').first().json.body.customer_id || '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') + "'" }}
